label: Mojo: Start import worker
args: mkdir -p "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed" && rm -f "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.in" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.out" && mkfifo "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.in" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.out" && trap 'kill "$worker" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.in" "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.out"' EXIT INT TERM; moff serve --input "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.in" --output "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/.zed/moff.out" & worker=$!; wait "$worker"
